title: OpenHi-P Exoskeleton: Open-source, High-torque, and Portable hip exoskeleton
description: Controller firmware, host-PC human-in-the-loop optimization software, and hardware design files with the build guide of the OpenHi-P hip exoskeleton, accompanying the paper "An open-source, high-torque, and portable hip exoskeleton for physically demanding locomotion."
